# README banner

Created November 14, 2026 with OpenAI's built-in image generation tool.
The PNG is 2048 by 768 pixels.

The composition uses Basalio's existing generated editorial portrait and chrome-headphone artwork as visual references. The architecture, ribbon artwork, and interaction motifs are generated illustrations. This is promotional artwork, not a screenshot of the plugin interface.

The root README links to the image using a repository-relative path. These assets are excluded from Git archives by .gitattributes and from the plugin ZIP by the existing .github/ rule in .distignore.

## Generation prompt

Use case: ads-marketing.
Create one finished, exceptionally polished wide GitHub README header banner for Basalio, a free native WordPress interaction-block plugin for creative portfolios.
Canvas: landscape 2560 x 960 pixels, roughly 8:3. Full-bleed, designed to stay legible at 850 pixels wide.
Reference image 1 is the existing Basalio banner for brand palette, typography, and portrait identity ONLY. Do not repeat its portrait-dominated composition. Reference image 2 is the existing chrome-headphone portfolio artwork, for a recognizable product-artwork element.
Art direction: contemporary independent design studio, bold Swiss editorial typography, tactile high-end portfolio collage, controlled motion and depth. Warm almost-black background #1C1917; warm white #F6F4EF; sharp acid-yellow #EDFF10 accents; cobalt blue and vermilion accents. Crisp and sophisticated, with disciplined hierarchy and generous deliberate negative space.
Left 42 percent: at top an extremely clean large wordmark "Basalio." in bold modern grotesk sans serif, with acid-yellow terminal dot. Below, the headline on three emphatic lines: "Make your" / "work" / "move." The words work and move. may be italic grotesk, with very strong scale and beautiful optical spacing. At bottom left, a clearly legible two-line label "INTERACTION BLOCKS" / "FOR WORDPRESS". Do not render any additional body copy.
Right 58 percent: an art-directed layered still-life of portfolio work and interaction motifs, with three or four distinct rectangular panels, not a generic dashboard or a uniform bento grid. The main foreground pale-blue panel contains an oversized sculptural chrome headphone as in reference 2. A second warm-cream panel behind it presents a stunning minimalist brutalist stair / architectural arch photograph with hard sunlight and tactile stone. A third smaller vermilion panel includes the reference portrait as a small supporting crop, occupying at most 12 percent of the full banner, never the dominant image. Add a striking cobalt graphic poster with a cream sculptural ribbon or bold abstract letterform. Let some panels break the edge, use restrained overlap and physically plausible subtle shadows.
Meaningful interaction details: one acid-yellow before/after slider line with a circular two-arrow handle across the architectural panel, one crisp cream cursor arrow near the headline/foreground panel seam, and a short curved acid-yellow motion path ending in an arrow between two panels. Keep these three details distinct, minimal, confident, and avoid clutter. No random particles or ornamental floating blobs.
Exact visible text only: "Basalio." "Make your" "work" "move." "INTERACTION BLOCKS" "FOR WORDPRESS". No fake product UI text, no buttons, no watermarks, no version numbers, no third-party brand logos. All typography must be perfectly readable and spelled exactly. No gradients on the background. This should feel like a beautifully composed motion-design studio campaign, with multiple compelling elements, not a portrait ad.
